value.change_explanation: Added separate predicate interfaces for every acquired quantitative section 63(f) head having an independently testable legal condition. The predicates reuse the existing tri-state age, blindness, marital-status, surviving-spouse, and spouse-exemption calculations without deriving applicability from a numeric amount. Section 63(c)(3) remains unchanged because it is an unconditional definition of the total as a sum, so no applicability predicate was invented. All existing functions, quantities, host code, and source material remain unchanged.

fields.name: taxpayer_attained_65_before_close
fields.question: Does the case explicitly state that the taxpayer attained age 65 before the close of the taxable year?

units_additions.property: Whether the taxpayer satisfies the age condition for the taxpayer-side aged additional amount under section 63(f)(1)(A).
units_additions.quote: if he has attained age 65 before the close of his taxable year

fields.name: taxpayer_married
fields.question: Does the case explicitly state that the taxpayer was married at the relevant close-of-year time?

fields.name: legally_separated_under_decree
fields.question: Does the case explicitly state that the taxpayer was legally separated from the spouse under a decree of divorce or separate maintenance?

fields.name: spouse_attained_65_before_close
fields.question: Does the case explicitly state that the taxpayer's spouse attained age 65 before the close of the taxable year?

fields.name: spouse_exemption_allowable
fields.question: Does the case explicitly GIVE that an additional exemption under section 151(b) was allowable to the taxpayer for the spouse?

fields.name: joint_return_made
fields.question: Does the case explicitly state that the taxpayer and spouse made a joint return?

fields.name: spouse_had_no_gross_income
fields.question: Does the case explicitly state that the spouse had no gross income for the relevant calendar year?

fields.name: spouse_dependent_of_another_taxpayer
fields.question: Does the case explicitly state that the spouse was the dependent of another taxpayer for the relevant calendar year?

units_additions.property: Whether the acquired marital, spouse-age, and section 151(b) spouse-exemption conditions for the spouse-side aged additional amount all hold.
units_additions.quote: for the spouse of the taxpayer if the spouse has attained age 65 before the close of the taxable year and an additional exemption is allowable to the taxpayer for such spouse under section 151(b).

fields.name: taxpayer_blind_at_close
fields.question: Does the case explicitly state that the taxpayer was blind at the close of the taxable year?

units_additions.property: Whether the taxpayer satisfies the blindness condition for the taxpayer-side blind additional amount under section 63(f)(2)(A).
units_additions.quote: if he is blind at the close of the taxable year

unresolved: Same-year spousal death and marital-status situations beyond the preserved legal-separation and explicitly supplied surviving-spouse facts remain unresolved when the available fields do not determine status.

Independent derivation of the section 2(a) dependent and deduction-entitlement condition remains unavailable because section 152 was not supplied; the preserved combined household/dependent fact is still required.
No separate predicate is added for section 63(c)(3), whose supplied source is an unconditional definition rather than a conditional quantitative entitlement rule.
